plugins.label: Tournament Access
plugins.description: Closes a tournament server to everyone not on the tournament roster. The tournament hub writes the roster (players and casters) into the server's Redis; when the hub marks it enforced, players not on it are kicked as they load, casters are kept in spectator, and on a lobby server everyone stays in spectator. The server owner and players at the bypass permission level are never checked.

plugins.label: Chat RCON
plugins.description: Lets referees and admins run server console commands from chat with !rcon <command>. Referees (permission level Referee Permission Level and up) may run only the Referee-Allowed Commands; admins (Admin Permission Level and up) may run anything except the Admin-Denied Commands. Takes over the stock !rcon while enabled, and every use is written to the server log.

plugins.label: ⚠️ chat_rcon test copy - not a plugin, do not enable
plugins.description: A copy of chat_rcon's permission rules that this repository's tests import. chat_rcon.py has the same rules built in and does not need this file on a server.

plugins.label: Lobby
plugins.description: For a lobby server: tells each player which game server to join and shows its /connect address on screen after a short countdown. Quake Live does not let a server move a player, so players type the command themselves. A player's destination comes from a personal route set by a referee, a tournament assignment the hub writes into the server's Redis, or the default destination.

plugins.label: Match Restore
plugins.description: Saves the state of a running match and puts it back later. A checkpoint holds player positions, health, armor, weapons, ammo, powerups and score, item respawn timers, dropped items and the match clock. Admins (permission 5) build, check and apply checkpoints with !restore, or restore a moment from a recorded .qlmatch demo pack. Needs the minqlxtended runtime; downloading it also fetches the restore/ folder.

plugins.label: ⚠️ match_restore helper - do not enable
plugins.description: Helper module for match_restore.py, downloaded with it. It is not a plugin: do not add it to qlx_plugins.

plugins.label: Match Restore Lab
plugins.description: Extra test and debug commands for match_restore: item respawn timers, item entity tools, setting the match clock by hand and restoring a single player. Not needed for a real restore. Needs match_restore enabled.

plugins.label: Telemetry (Unified)
plugins.description: Sends live match data from this instance to ql-stats-hub through the host's telemetry relay: player positions and stats, item pickups, and match events such as chat, votes, pauses, kills and !call referee requests. Turn the relay on for the host, then enable this instance on its Telemetry tab (telemetry-relay addon), which reserves its server ID and turns this plugin on. Each feed has its own switch.

plugins.label: ⚠️ telemetry helper - do not enable
plugins.description: Helper module for stream_telemetry_unified.py, downloaded with it. It is not a plugin: do not add it to qlx_plugins.

plugins.label: ⚠️ telemetry helper - do not enable
plugins.description: Helper module for stream_telemetry_unified.py, downloaded with it. It is not a plugin: do not add it to qlx_plugins.

plugins.label: Referee Call
plugins.description: Adds the !call chat command, which any player or spectator can use to ask for a referee. It only answers the caller; the call reaches the referees as a chat line that stream_telemetry_unified forwards to ql-stats-hub, so that plugin must be enabled with Session Events (qlx_statsHubFeedSession) on. One call per player per 60 seconds.

addons.label: Demos
addons.description: Adds a Demos screen for each instance: lists the demo files the server recorded, newest first, with all files of one match grouped in one row labelled with map, mode, players and length, and downloads them. Filters by date, map, mode and pack state. Install qlmatch-packer as well to see and rebuild .qlmatch packs. Needs QLSM with ui_api 3 or newer.

addons.label: Live Demo Stream (experimental)
addons.description: Experimental, not yet verified end to end. Lets a spectator watch a player's view live: points an instance's sv_demoStream cvars at the central demo-stream relay and registers the instance with ql-stats-hub. Set the relay address and the stats-hub in Settings, then enable each instance from its Live Demo Stream menu entry, which restarts it. Needs a game server build that supports the sv_demoStream cvars.

addons.label: Player Ranks
addons.description: Shows each connected player's external rating in Live Status. Pick the sources per instance on its Ranks tab: qlstats, Slipgate and x76. qlstats and Slipgate connection details are set once for the installation; x76 is configured per instance. Every enabled source is fetched in one request and stacked in a single Rank column. Needs QLSM with ui_api 4 or newer.

addons.label: Qlmatch Packer
addons.description: Installs the qlmatch packer and Node.js 22 on every game host during host setup and Update Plugins, and shows its .qlmatch packs and replay files on the Demos screen. Nothing runs the packer after a match: a first pack is built by running pack.mjs on the host by hand, and the Demos screen can rebuild an existing pack or its replay file. The output name template and rclone upload targets are the cvars qlx_qlmatchNameTemplate and qlx_qlmatchRcloneTargets, set by hand in the instance's server.cfg. Needs the demo-management addon.

addons.label: Runtime Source
addons.description: Builds a host's minqlxtended from a repository you choose instead of the commit QLSM pins, for example the alexeytihomirov/minqlxtended fork that native demo capture needs. Enable it for a host, enter the repository and a commit, then run Re-run Host Setup. Needs a QLSM whose host setup supports a custom minqlxtended repository on every provider (host.setup hook).

addons.label: Telemetry Relay
addons.description: Sends live telemetry from game instances (player positions, item pickups, match events) to ql-stats-hub through a relay on each host. Set the stats-hub URL and ingest token in Settings, turn the relay on per host (host menu, Telemetry Relay), then enable each instance on its Telemetry tab. The instances need the stream_telemetry_unified plugin.
